rules.starting_levels_source: [bot] the default Swirl and Arrow show 3 level dots

special.text: Moving forward into an adjacent enemy swaps places; both keep their facing.
Pushes an enemy in front of him by moving forward.
Phases through enemies in front by moving forward; when moving, advances as far as possible.
Throws an enemy standing behind her by moving backward.
Swap Toss directly in front of or behind her by moving into them.
